data.location: Keystone, Colorado (River Run Village base area)
data.status: opened to the public on Thursday, May 7, 2026
data.short_description: Kindred Resort opened on May 7, 2026 as Keystone, Colorado's first luxury hotel and the newest addition to the RockResorts collection. The ski-in/ski-out development features 107 guest rooms, 95 luxury residences, and private club access in the River Run Village base area. The property is centered around a "Campfire Luxury" concept built around connection, community, and seamless mountain access.

Ramen Danbo announced it will open a new location at 3982 Main St. in Vancouver's Riley Park-Little Mountain neighbourhood. The restaurant, known for its Fukuoka-style Tonkatsu ramen, currently operates four other provincial locations plus outposts in Seattle and New York. No opening date has been shared.

Pet Supplies Plus opened at 8809 Lakeview Pkwy. in Rowlett, Texas, owned by local franchise partners Todd McEvoy and Alan Mann, marking their second DFW-area location after opening in Euless in March. The store offers pet essentials, grooming, self-pet wash stations, and carry-out assistance. A grand opening celebration is scheduled for May 16 and 17, 2026.

Raffaeles Pizza, a Valley-area restaurant specializing in New York-style and Sicilian slices and pies, is set to close on May 30. It is one of five Valley restaurants mentioned in the article as closing in May. No street address was provided in the article text.

Serrano's Mexican Food, a family-owned Mexican restaurant at its McKellips Road location for over 34 years, announced it is closing this month. The owners cited a steady decline in business, rising operating costs, and ongoing road construction in front of the restaurant as contributing factors. A closing announcement was posted to the restaurant's social media pages.

data.location: Tamaya Market on Beach Boulevard, Jacksonville, FL
data.short_description: Bark Street Puppies is set to open a new pet store at Tamaya Market on Beach Boulevard in Jacksonville, amid community opposition including a petition with over 3,600 signatures citing concerns about puppies sourced from commercial breeders. Store manager Shaun Carey states the company carefully vets its breeders and that all puppies are up to date on vaccinations. The store has received approval from Animal Care and Protective services.

data.location: 4031 Davis Drive, McCrimmon Corners, Morrisville, NC
data.short_description: Lotte Plaza Market, a Pan-Asian grocery chain selling fruit, vegetables, meats and international foods, is planning to open its first North Carolina location at McCrimmon Corners in Morrisville. The store will occupy more than 48,000 square feet next to the dog-grooming business Swifthounds, in a space previously occupied by a Harris Teeter. Opening is expected in the second half of 2027.

BJ's Wholesale Club recently opened its first Texas location in Forney, marking its entry into its 22nd state and its 264th warehouse club store overall. The expansion represents BJ's push into territory long dominated by Costco and Sam's Club, targeting high-demand areas with growing populations. BJ's leadership has stated plans to open between 25 and 30 new clubs by the end of 2026.

BJ's Wholesale Club has a planned location in Grand Prairie in the Dallas-Fort Worth area as part of its Texas expansion strategy. The company recently opened its first Texas location in Forney and has multiple additional DFW-area sites in development. BJ's aims to open between 25 and 30 new clubs by end of 2026.

BJ's Wholesale Club has a planned location in Fort Worth as part of its Dallas-Fort Worth market expansion. This follows the recent opening of the company's first Texas club in Forney and is part of a broader plan to open 25 to 30 new clubs by end of 2026. BJ's is targeting areas with high demand and booming populations across new states.

BJ's Wholesale Club has a planned location in Waxahachie, Texas, as part of its broader Dallas-Fort Worth expansion. The company recently opened its first Texas store in Forney and is aggressively entering markets traditionally dominated by Costco and Sam's Club. BJ's plans to open 25 to 30 new clubs by the end of 2026.

data.location: 4205 Hacks Cross Road, Suite 111, Memphis, TN 38125
data.status: opening timeline is not presently available
data.short_description: Petra Pastry, a Jordanian-Palestinian bakery founded by Asad Almalhi and his wife Maisaa Hassan, was issued a certificate of occupancy for a 1,400-square-foot storefront at 4205 Hacks Cross Road, Suite 111 in Memphis. The bakery specializes in traditional sweets including kunafa, baklava, and basbousa, and already operates an existing location at 5804 Raleigh Lagrange Road. No opening timeline has been announced for the second location.

data.location: California (primarily Southern California; some Northern California)
data.status: sale process underway amid Chapter 11 proceedings
data.short_description: National Franchise Sales (NFS) is managing the marketing and sale of approximately 50 Carl's Jr. restaurant locations operated by Sun Gir Incorporated and its affiliated entities, as part of a Chapter 11 bankruptcy proceeding pending in the U.S. Bankruptcy Court for the Central District of California. The portfolio is located primarily in Southern California with a smaller presence in Northern California markets. NFS is coordinating due diligence and identifying qualified buyers to maximize value for stakeholders.
N/A

data.location: Ross Park Mall, Allegheny County (Ross Township), Pennsylvania
data.short_description: JCPenney announced it will permanently close its Ross Park Mall location in Allegheny County, Pennsylvania on September 20, citing an inability to secure viable lease terms and failure to find an alternative location in the market. The anchor store had previously downsized to a single floor in 2019. JCPenney stated it will continue serving customers through its nearly 650 remaining stores nationwide and its digital platform.

Lexington nonprofit FoodChain opened its new Neighborhood Green Grocery store earlier in May 2026 at 501 W. 6th Street, next to its aquaponics farm and kitchen. The store prioritizes locally grown Kentucky products at fair prices and features a miniature aquaponics farm with seedlings for sale near the entrance. FoodChain was founded in 2011 and expanded in 2013 to include Kentucky's first commercial-scale indoor aquaponics farm.

Sushi Sake filed permit applications with the Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation to open a restaurant at 5829 SW 73 Street in South Miami, at the former Kiko Sushi location. No opening date has been announced, though the restaurant's Instagram confirms it is "opening soon." Founded in 2009 by brothers James and Argelio Aguayo, Sushi Sake offers traditional Japanese sushi and Latin-American-inspired rolls across more than three dozen South Florida locations.
N/A

data.status: could officially open to shoppers by the end of July
data.short_description: Bliss Marketplace, a locally owned vintage and artisan vendor marketplace operating in Rancho Cordova, Roseville and Midtown Sacramento, is preparing to open its largest location yet — a 22,000-square-foot storefront at Folsom Premium Outlets featuring approximately 200 vendor booths. The new space, more than double the size of its current largest location, will sell retro furniture, collectibles, artisan jewelry, handmade décor, clothing and antiques. The Folsom location will be the company's fourth storefront and is expected to open by end of July 2026.

Busy Ant Supermarket is set to open June 1 at 10 a.m. in Georgiana, Alabama, restoring local grocery access after the previous store's closure left residents traveling outside the area for groceries. Managed by Parth Patel, the store will include a deli, meat department and expanded services, operating daily from 8 a.m. to 8 p.m. City officials called the opening a moment of "investment, resilience, progress and belief" in the community's future.

data.event_date: Opened early December (year not specified in article); grand opening/ribbon cutting May 22, 2026
data.status: grand opening and ribbon cutting held May 22, 2026
data.short_description: Salon Idyll, a full-service salon and spa with tanning services owned by Mckaylee Beeter and Larissa Valdivieso, held its grand opening and ribbon cutting at 400 Lincoln Highway in Rochelle on May 22, at the former Hallmark building. The business opened in early December and the event was hosted by the Rochelle Chamber of Commerce and city of Rochelle. City and chamber officials praised the owners for revitalizing a vacant downtown space.

data.location: Matthews Gateway development, off East John Street, Matthews, NC 28105
data.status: confirmed plans; no opening timeline announced
data.short_description: Trader Joe's has confirmed plans to open a new location in Matthews, North Carolina as part of the Matthews Gateway mixed-use development off East John Street, though no opening timeline or exact address has been announced. The proposed store would occupy roughly 13,500 square feet, according to public planning documents. This would be Trader Joe's fourth Charlotte-area location, joining existing stores in Midtown, Rea Farms and University City.

data.location: 10 W. Main St., Madison Village, OH
data.status: relocated and opened at new location on March 30, 2026
data.short_description: Simplicity Studio, a hair salon operating in Madison Village since 2016, relocated from its original address at 2 W. Main Street to a purchased building at 10 W. Main Street, just three doors down. Owner Kelly DiBiase undertook an extensive renovation of the new space before beginning hair services there on March 30, 2026. The new building previously housed Main Street Retreat Massage and Wellness Center.
N/A

Pittsburgh-based Millie's Ice Cream is slated to open its first Maryland location at 202 Ellington Blvd. in Gaithersburg, in the space most recently occupied by The Crepe Shoppe before it relocated. No opening date has been announced. Founded in 2014 by Chad and Lauren Townsend, Millie's has grown to include multiple scoop shop locations in the greater Pittsburgh area, a food truck, franchising, and packaged pints in local grocery stores.

Four Sisters Cafe, a family-owned breakfast and lunch restaurant in Roseville, announced plans to open a companion coffee shop, Four Sisters Coffee, in the same shopping center at 9050 Fairway Drive. The coffee shop is described as an extension of the cafe launched 14 years ago by sisters Gina Sanders, Tricia Cleland, Julie Geffre and Lisa Lees. No specific opening date has been announced; the sisters are actively hiring baristas for the new location.
N/A

data.location: One North redevelopment area near Diamond Parkway, North Kansas City, MO
data.status: set to open sometime next year
data.short_description: North Kansas City Council approved plans for Fresh Market of Northtown, a 51,000-square-foot full-service grocery store to be located within the One North redevelopment area near Diamond Parkway, ending roughly three decades without a full-service grocer in the city. The store, a branch of locally owned World Fresh Market and El Mercado Fresco, will feature meat counters, fresh produce, a bakery and a small restaurant. Mayor Jesse Smith called it a "historic moment" for North Kansas City, describing it as the culmination of a seven-year effort to address the area's food desert.

data.location: 106 South Street SE, Market Station, Leesburg, VA
data.short_description: Pikes Peak Lemonade Company announced a soft opening at its new retail shop at 106 South Street SE in the Market Station center in downtown Leesburg, Virginia, beginning May 28, 2026. The company, founded in 2015 in Colorado, specializes in lemonade and limeade concentrates in flavors such as Hibiscus, Mulberry and Cherry Blossom, along with cocktail mixes, simple syrups and fresh lemonades served on-site. Soft opening hours run through the weekend, ending Sunday.

data.location: 291 Boston Turnpike, Marketplace Shrewsbury, Shrewsbury, MA
data.short_description: Hooters announced the closure of its Shrewsbury location at 291 Boston Turnpike, which had operated since 2015 at Marketplace Shrewsbury, citing the closure in a social media post that thanked the community and staff. The closure follows Hooters of America's Chapter 11 bankruptcy filing last spring and a wave of nationwide permanent closures in 2024 due to market pressures. The Shrewsbury location noted it looked forward to customers continuing to be served at the chain's other Massachusetts locations in Dedham, Saugus and West Springfield.

data.location: Hamilton Avenue, Larimer neighborhood, Pittsburgh, PA
data.short_description: Goodlander announced its taproom will close effective June 6, just ahead of its fifth anniversary. The Pittsburgh craft cocktail brewery opened on Hamilton Avenue in May 2021. Final events include an anniversary celebration on May 31.

data.location: Butler Street, Lawrenceville neighborhood, Pittsburgh, PA
data.short_description: The Abbey on Butler Street in Pittsburgh's Lawrenceville neighborhood has filed for bankruptcy. It is among multiple Pittsburgh-area establishments facing uncertain futures.

data.location: 1150 Carlisle Street, Penn Township (North Point Plaza), PA
data.short_description: Planet Fitness will open a second Hanover-area location in the North Point Plaza, occupying a 14,335-square-foot former Joann Fabrics space. The store is listed as "coming soon" on the chain's website.

data.location: 1750 Homer M. Adams Parkway, Alton, IL
data.short_description: Jersey Mike's Subs opened a new Alton location on Wednesday, drawing a packed lunch crowd. The site, owned by franchisees Mike Lanman and Alex Gowin, was converted from a former T-Mobile storefront. It operates daily from 10 a.m. to 9 p.m.

data.location: David March Park, Santa Clarita, CA
data.short_description: The city of Santa Clarita is expanding David March Park, centered on a 116-step outdoor exercise staircase. The 8-acre expansion includes a basketball court, baseball field, two parking lots, and a picnic pavilion.
Norwegian Cruise Line's six-acre Great Tides Waterpark will open on Great Stirrup Cay in the Bahamas on September 4, 2026. *(See Non-working list — Outside USA/Canada)*

Clover Food Labs will close all restaurants and meal box delivery operations, affecting about 170 employees, with Thursday as its final day. The Cambridge-based vegetarian chain blamed rising operating expenses from inflation and post-pandemic pressures.

data.location: 10040 Hwy. 6, Ste. 400, Missouri City, TX (Shops at Vicksburg)
data.short_description: Firehouse Subs opened in the Shops at Vicksburg in Missouri City. The counter-service restaurant offers hot specialty subs and salads with a 13-option hot sauce bar. It is owned by local franchisees Saadat Khan and his wife.

Mountain Mike's Pizza opened its second McKinney location, its 14th in Texas. The 2,600-square-foot restaurant is owned by franchisee family Steve, Kelly and Adam Zeigler and features eight big-screen TVs and an all-you-can-eat weekday lunch option.

H-E-B filed plans for a 99K SF Mi Tienda store at PlazAmericas Mall, proposed to open around March 2028. Construction is slated to start in February at a cost of about $24M. It would be the third Mi Tienda location.

AMC permanently ceased operations at AMC Salina 10 after an April hailstorm caused extensive roof and water damage. AMC decided not to renew its lease, leaving Salina without a movie theater. The mall is in talks with three other theater companies.

Five Below opened a new location in the Atascocita Commons shopping center in Humble in early March, in the space previously occupied by Party City. It offers fitness items, beauty products, pet supplies, candy, home essentials and tech items.

data.store_name: Thai Wisdom LLC / TWB Edmonds LLC
data.status: file for bankruptcy; locations remain open
data.short_description: Thai restaurant chain Thai Wisdom LLC and subsidiary TWB Edmonds LLC filed for bankruptcy on May 26 in the Western District of Washington, listing assets up to $50,000 and liabilities between $500,000 and $1 million. Founded in 2017, it continues to operate its establishments.

data.location: former McAlister's location next to Chick-Fil-A, Brentwood, TN
data.short_description: Edley's BBQ announced it will open a new Brentwood location later this year in the former McAlister's restaurant. The restaurant said it had waited 10 years for the right Brentwood spot. No exact date was shared.

Suzu, a Japanese restaurant from Chef Makoto Okuwa, is set to open in July in Madisonville, making it the first Makoto brick-and-mortar in the Midwest. It offers 150 indoor and 70 outdoor dining seats, a 10-seat Edo-style omakase counter, and a tea room.

data.location: 15999 Pines Blvd., Pembroke Pines, FL (Westfork Plaza)
data.short_description: Brazil-based Oakberry Acai will open at Westfork Plaza in Pembroke Pines, replacing the former I Heart Mac & Cheese restaurant. The opening date has not been announced; it is listed as "Coming Soon" on the brand's website and passed food licensing inspection on May 12.

data.location: 102 South Armed Forces Blvd., Warner Robins, GA
data.short_description: Fincher's Barbecue opened its new Warner Robins location on May 15, replacing its former Davis Drive restaurant. The generational family business is known for pulled and chopped pork, Brunswick stew, and signature sauce.

The Presbyterian Community Center will celebrate the grand opening of its new 15,000-square-foot building on May 29 with an open house and ribbon cutting. The facility supports Emergency Services and the Pathways for Youth after-school program.
Norwegian Cruise Line set Sept. 4 as the opening date for its six-acre Great Tides Waterpark at Great Stirrup Cay. *(See Non-working list — Outside USA/Canada)*
Article reports a list of new BJ's Wholesale Club locations opening in Florida. *(See Non-working list — content not retrievable, MSN)*

data.location: OS 1515 on Government Springs, Crave Food Hall, Ocean Springs, MS
data.short_description: Salty Jax will close its Crave Food Hall location in Ocean Springs on Sunday, May 31. Owners Ngoc Nguyen and Lu Duong are relocating.

Owners of Salty Jax announced they will open a new stand-alone restaurant in D'Iberville. The exact location and opening date have not been disclosed. Their food truck will continue operating across South Mississippi.

data.location: 2060 1st Avenue South, St. Petersburg, FL (Grand Central District)
data.short_description: The Yard Gym, a social-fitness club focused on strength and conditioning, will open in the former Grayspeed Cycles space, targeting a grand opening on Saturday, June 13. The 3,264-square-foot facility is the company's first in Florida and is owned by franchisee Taylor Dove.

data.location: Terminal C, Boston Logan International Airport, Boston, MA
data.short_description: Mike's Pastry is opening a new location at Logan Airport in Terminal C, with hours of 5 a.m. to 10 p.m. seven days a week. The outlet will offer cannoli, cheesecake, lobster tails, ready-to-go items and espresso drinks.

data.location: 4520 Destination Drive, Grandscape, The Colony, TX
data.short_description: White Castle announced plans to open its first-ever Texas location at Grandscape in The Colony, with a groundbreaking ceremony on June 2. The 105-year-old Ohio-based chain will serve its sliders once construction is finished.

Dolly Parton's first travel stop is set to open June 24 in Cornersville, about 60 miles south of Nashville. The flagship will feature barbecue from DLY BBQ, coffee from Dolly's Cup of Ambition, a full-service restaurant, merchandise, a custom mural and a replica tour bus.
Hawaiian Bros opened a new location in Norman, Oklahoma. *(Article body not available beyond headline)*

Guzman Y Gomez closed all eight of its U.S. locations in the Chicago metro area, effective May 22. Former employees filed a class action lawsuit claiming the chain closed without the 60-day notice required by federal and Illinois law.

data.location: One North development, near Diamond Parkway, North Kansas City, MO
data.short_description: The North Kansas City Council approved plans for a 51,000-square-foot Fresh Market of Northtown grocery store, expected to open in 2027. It will be a branch of the locally owned World Fresh Market and El Mercado Fresco, featuring meat and seafood counters, deli, bakery, and a café.

Stacks Espresso Bar opened its fifth Capital Region location at 90 State Street in Albany on Wednesday, taking over the former Stagecoach Coffee space. The State Street menu focuses on contemporary brewing techniques and sustainable practices.

Clover Food Lab will close all 11 of its Greater Boston locations Thursday, ending a 17-year run and affecting around 170 employees. The company blamed COVID "hangover effects" and inflation, noting ingredient costs rose 30–50% over two years.

Matsu, a modern Japanese fine-dining restaurant, will close its Oceanside location on May 31 and relocate within Oceanside. Chef-owner William Eick is searching for a new space; the brand will continue operating after relocating.

Country star Dolly Parton will officially open Dolly's Tennessean Travel Stop on June 24, 2026, at exit 22 off I-65 in Cornersville, Tennessee, described as a "first-of-its-kind travel center experience." The stop will feature DLY BBQ, Dolly's Cup of Ambition Coffee, a sit-down cafe, an original mural, and an onsite tour bus inspired by Parton's career. Grand opening festivities details will be announced at a later date.

New owners John and Kelly Piccinnini are taking over Sag Harbor's iconic The Corner Bar at 1 Main Street, retaining the name while refreshing the concept with updated design, brand, and menu. The space is currently under construction and expected to open in July 2026 if all goes according to plan. Fan-favorite classics like a signature burger and fish and chips will remain alongside new modern comfort food offerings.

The Sidney Tim Hortons on Vancouver Island closed the week prior to May 27, 2026, and was completely gutted in preparation for a new layout as part of a $400 million nationwide renovation campaign. The location is expected to reopen in about two weeks, with nearly a dozen Vancouver Island locations slated for upgrades in 2026 as part of 43 total BC renovations. The broader campaign also includes building eight new BC Tim Hortons restaurants.

Lily Leedom, founder of small-batch sea salt brand Saltery (formerly Duxbury Saltworks), opened a brick-and-mortar store this month at 36 Railroad Ave. in Duxbury, Massachusetts. The shop sells over 50 flavors of hand-harvested sea salt from Duxbury Bay, including truffle salt ($38), ice cream sundae dessert salt ($35), and original Duxbury flake salt ($28). Store hours are noon to 4 p.m. Fridays and Saturdays, or by appointment and for special events.

The Hoskinson Health and Wellness Clinic in Wyoming, opened in 2023 by Cardano founder Charles Hoskinson at a cost of $250 million, will close on July 31, 2026, after rapid expansion and spending made it "financially unsustainable." The clinic had promised to be "the Mayo Clinic of the West" and had seen between 18,000 and 20,000 patients, but underwent two rounds of layoffs in late 2025 and early 2026. Patients were encouraged to contact their doctors before the closing date to avoid interruptions in treatment.

The Apple Store at Towson Town Center—the first Apple retail store in the U.S. to unionize—is set to close on June 20, 2026, with Apple citing "declining conditions" at the mall following the departure of several retailers. The closure will affect nearly 90 union employees, and the union filed an Unfair Labor Practice charge with the NLRB alleging discriminatory treatment, including that unionized Towson workers are not being permitted to transfer to other stores. Apple stated it will continue to abide by the union agreement regarding severance, with priority rehire rights if a new store opens within 50 miles within 18 months.

data.location: 2300 Grand Cypress Dr, Lutz, FL 33559 (Tampa Premium Outlets)
data.short_description: Old Navy, the Gap-owned apparel brand, will open at Tampa Premium Outlets at 2300 Grand Cypress Dr in Lutz, Florida, this November, occupying the space previously housing Saks Off 5th. The open-air outlet center describes itself as offering a curated mix of luxury, lifestyle, sport, and beauty brands. Old Navy, first launched in California in 1994, has grown to encompass more than 1,200 stores.
Article is a Miami taqueria opening in Bayside but no article content was retrieved.

data.location: 1001 W. Bay Area Blvd., Webster, TX (Baybrook Gateway)
data.short_description: Sprouts Farmers Market is opening a new location in Webster's Baybrook Gateway shopping center at 1001 W. Bay Area Blvd., with a ribbon cutting at 6:45 a.m. followed by doors officially opening at 7 a.m. on Friday. The first customers will receive freebies including reusable tote bags, flowers, and sample products as part of the grand opening celebration. The Webster store follows the earlier-opening Kingwood location and precedes a planned Spring location set for September.

data.location: 4775 W. Panther Creek Dr., Spring, TX
data.short_description: Sprouts Farmers Market plans to open a second new Houston-area location at 4775 W. Panther Creek Dr. in Spring, Texas, scheduled for September 2026. The Spring store follows the Webster and Kingwood openings as part of Sprouts' ongoing Texas expansion, the chain's second-largest market with 64 locations. Texas remains a priority growth market for Sprouts, which has more than 480 stores in 25 states nationwide.

data.location: 600 N. Edwards Blvd., Lake Geneva, Wisconsin
data.status: set to open to the public June 10
data.short_description: Natural Grocers, a family-operated organic grocery chain with more than 150 U.S. locations, will open its first Wisconsin store at 600 N. Edwards Blvd. in Lake Geneva on June 10, 2026, taking over a former Joann Fabrics location. The store marks the chain's first location close to Chicago and will serve the Lake Geneva community and surrounding southeastern Wisconsin and northern Illinois areas. Natural Grocers is known for its wide variety of natural and organic brands and free nutrition education offerings.

Article is a historical/nostalgic piece about the history of Smitty's grocery stores in Arizona, tracing events from 1961 through 1999 when the chain was absorbed by Fry's. No current opening or closure event is described.

data.location: 1621 S Main St, Fort Scott (inside Beauty Lounge Salon & Barbershop)
data.short_description: Holy Grounds Jesus & Coffee, a mobile coffee business originally founded in Nevada, Missouri in September 2025, will open its first physical location inside the Beauty Lounge Salon & Barbershop at 1621 S Main St in Fort Scott. The coffee shop has an estimated open date of mid-June 2026, offering hot and iced lattes with scripture written on every cup, as well as non-caffeinated drink options. Tentative hours are 9 a.m. to 5 p.m. Tuesday–Friday and 9 a.m. to 2 p.m. Saturdays.

A new Fox Communities Credit Union branch opened on April 13, 2026, at 2202 Monroe Road in Bellevue, Wisconsin, with the company having purchased the land in August 2023 for $1.7 million and begun construction in June 2025. The branch offers wire transfers, instant card issuance, signature guarantees, notary services, and lending and mortgage representatives. A ribbon-cutting event with the Greater Green Bay Chamber was held on May 27, 2026.

data.location: 1713 James L Redman Pkwy, Plant City, FL 33563
data.short_description: ANF Gyros & Grill is expanding to its ninth location at 1713 James L Redman Pkwy in Plant City, Florida, joining a small retail center anchored by furniture store Southern Hospitality alongside other food establishments. The brand, founded in 2009 in Winter Haven, has expanded to several Central Florida locations including Orlando, Ocala, and Gainesville. No opening date has been announced; the owner was not immediately available for comment.

Crisp & Chew, an artisan bakery specializing in elevated oatmeal cookies, held a sold-out soft opening on May 7, 2026, and will host its official Grand Opening celebration on June 16, 2026, at 11:30 AM at 1612 Williams Dr in Georgetown, Texas. The event will include a ribbon-cutting ceremony, complimentary cookies, refreshments, and exclusive giveaways. The bakery was founded by Sarah Davis and Qudduws Ware, growing from a local farmers market presence into this brick-and-mortar storefront.

data.status: expected to be completed by November
data.short_description: Kerrville-based jewelry retailer James Avery has filed plans to open a new location in Little Elm, Texas, expected to be completed by November 2026, according to state documents. The new Little Elm location will add to a growing list of Dallas-Fort Worth cities with a James Avery store, joining Plano, Mesquite, Frisco, Allen, and Prosper. Additional address details are in a paywalled portion of the article.

data.location: 10645 Braddock Road, Unit B2, Fairfax, VA
data.short_description: Another Broken Egg Cafe has opened a new location at 10645 Braddock Road, Unit B2, in Fairfax, Virginia, near George Mason University's main campus, owned and operated by franchisee Demetrios Florakis of EOS Ventures Inc. The cafe serves breakfast, brunch, and lunch daily from 7 a.m. to 2 p.m. and includes a full bar with cocktails, mocktails, mimosas, and Bloody Marys. It is the franchisee's third Virginia location alongside existing cafes in Williamsburg and Virginia Beach.

Target opened its first Johnston County store on May 17, 2026, at 551 St. Mark Ave. in Selma, anchoring the Eastfield development. The nearly 129,000-square-foot location employs around 140 people and includes an Apple at Target, CVS Pharmacy, and Starbucks Café. It is Target's 56th location in North Carolina, opening the same day as a Myrtle Grove store.

data.location: Platform development, near downtown Raleigh, NC (address not specified)
data.short_description: Bright Side Books & Wine, a specialty bookstore focused on romance, held its grand opening on April 25, 2026, in the Platform development near downtown Raleigh. The shop is owned by Susannah Baird and will eventually serve wine once it obtains its ABC license; non-alcoholic drinks were offered at the grand opening.

data.status: last day at Village District was April 28
data.short_description: Furniture retailer Nadeau Raleigh's last day at its Village District location at 426 Woodburn Road was April 28, 2026, as the store prepared to relocate to a larger space on Capital Boulevard. The store liquidated inventory ahead of the move, with the new Capital Boulevard location expected to open by mid- to late-May 2026.

data.status: expected to open by mid- to late-May
data.short_description: Furniture retailer Nadeau Raleigh is relocating to a larger space at 1405 Capital Blvd., expected to open by mid- to late-May 2026, after closing its Village District location on April 28. The new Capital Boulevard location is described as larger than the previous Village District space.

data.location: 50th and France shopping center, Edina, Minnesota
data.short_description: MeatEater is opening its third retail store at the 50th and France shopping center in Edina, Minnesota—the brand's first location in Minnesota—with a grand opening date and associated events to be announced separately. The immersive retail experience will bring together MeatEater's content-driven storytelling, high-performance gear, and programming for hunters, anglers, and conservationists. It follows the brand's flagship in Bozeman, MT (2024) and a second location at The Corners of Brookfield outside Milwaukee (2025).

data.location: Red Bank, New Jersey (address not specified)
data.status: closed for good on Saturday, May 23
data.short_description: The Super Foodtown in Red Bank, New Jersey, a family-owned grocery store that operated for 50 years, permanently closed on May 23, 2026. Store CEO Lou Scaduto Jr. cited a decade of change in the supermarket landscape, fierce competition from new chain stores including ShopRite, Uncle Giuseppe's, and Aldi, and a shift toward corporate and foreign-owned supermarket models. The store is owned by local company Food Circus Super Markets.

data.status: permanently closing with a last day of service on Sunday, May 31
data.short_description: Standard Service, located at 400 Jesse Jewell Parkway in Gainesville, is permanently closing after four years in business. The restaurant's last day of service is Sunday, May 31, 2026.

data.location: Brighton, CO (815-acre planned community, 22 miles from Denver)
data.short_description: Century Communities will celebrate the Grand Opening of Brighton Crossings' newest phase on Saturday, May 30, 2026, debuting two new floor plan collections with model homes in this 815-acre planned community in Brighton, Colorado. The event will feature model tours, refreshments, and a giveaway, with nearly 200 new homesites available in the community. Brighton Crossings is located 22 miles from Denver, 12 miles from Thornton, and 18 miles from Denver International Airport.

Na'cho Margarita, a popular Mexican restaurant with two existing Midlands, South Carolina locations, announced it is planning a third location at 2064 Wilson Road in Newberry. No opening date has been publicly announced, though the company indicated an announcement could come "very soon" on its Facebook page. The restaurant is known for its unique take on traditional Mexican dishes, seafood creations, and margaritas.

data.location: Springfield (southeast part of the city; address not specified)
data.short_description: The AMC Springfield 11 movie theater in the southeast part of Springfield was scheduled to be temporarily closed on May 26–27, 2026, citing a water issue. The brief available text identifies the closure as being due to a water main leak; no further details about reopening timelines are provided in the accessible article text.

data.status: Thursday will be the last day of business
data.short_description: Clover Food Lab, a Cambridge-based vegetarian fast-food chain with about a dozen Boston-area restaurants, is permanently closing all locations and its meal box delivery service after 17 years, with Thursday as the last day of business. CEO Julia Wrin Piper cited rising costs—with food prices up 30–50% over the past two years—along with increased delivery costs and other overhead as making the business unsustainable. The company had previously filed for bankruptcy in 2023 but emerged and planned to expand before ultimately closing.

data.location: 2588 Capital Ave SW, Battle Creek, MI 49015
data.short_description: The new Jack in the Box location at 2588 Capital Ave SW in Battle Creek, Michigan, has been delayed from its original April 2026 and then May 2026 projected openings to June 2026, per the chain's website. Construction began in August 2025 on what is the first Jack in the Box to open in Michigan in over 20 years, with plans to build five area restaurants across Southwest Michigan over the next few years. Staff training was reported to have begun in early May 2026.

data.status: will officially open to the public on Thursday, May 28, 2026
data.short_description: The new Oakridge Park shopping centre, a complete redevelopment of the former Oakridge Centre, will officially open on May 28, 2026, marking the first and largest phase with 650,000 sq. ft. of leasable retail and restaurant space. Approximately 100 retailers and food and beverage businesses are expected to be ready for opening day, followed by select anchor tenants opening a few weeks later. A ribbon-cutting ceremony will precede the morning public opening.

Time Out Market Vancouver, described as Canada's second Time Out Market food hall and a "key anchor attraction," is ready for Oakridge Park's May 28, 2026, opening day. The food hall is part of the renowned global Time Out Market chain of upscale food and beverage destinations. No specific suite address within the mall was provided in the article.

data.location: Euclid Avenue, Toronto, Ontario, Canada (no street number specified)
data.short_description: Alley Pocha, a new Korean restaurant inspired by traditional pocha (street stall) culture, is opening next month (June 2026) on Euclid Avenue in Toronto, taking over the address previously occupied by Thay Bar. The restaurant aims to recreate the cozy, late-night social atmosphere of Korean street food culture with an immersive space designed to resemble a Seoul side street. The team, drawn together by a shared love of Korean cuisine, plans to offer food, drinks, and a warm community atmosphere.

data.status: on schedule for an official opening and ribbon-cutting ceremony in fall 2026
data.short_description: Sheetz announced its $169 million distribution facility at 5900 Township Road 230 in Findlay, Ohio, is on schedule for an official opening and ribbon-cutting ceremony in fall 2026, with a specific date to be announced later in the summer. Once operational, the facility will directly support Sheetz's expanding Midwest presence, including planned Indiana stores in greater Indianapolis next year. The company is currently hiring for nearly 200 positions at the facility, including food production, packaging, CDL-A drivers, and related roles.

data.status: will no longer operate as a full-time sports bar after June 7
data.short_description: KSBar and Grille in Lexington, Kentucky, announced it will no longer operate as a full-time, daily sports bar after June 7, 2026, citing rising food costs and ongoing economic struggles that made daily operations "unsustainable." The restaurant, which has operated for eight years as Kentucky Sports Radio's signature spot known for its wings and gameday atmosphere, will still open on gamedays. Owner Matt Jones described the end of daily operations with disappointment as the conclusion of "an amazing era."

data.location: Universal Islands of Adventure, Orlando, FL
data.short_description: Universal Orlando has begun demolition of its nearly 30-year-old Lost Continent themed area at Islands of Adventure, with venues and experiences set to permanently close in phases to make way for a new themed area that has not yet been announced. The area opened in 1999 and has been progressively reduced over the past 15 years, with its main attraction Poseidon's Fury having been closed since 2023 and the Eighth Voyage of Sinbad stunt show closed since 2018. Universal has confirmed that "construction activity will lead the way to future developments."

data.location: Lost Continent, Universal Islands of Adventure, Orlando, FL
data.short_description: Mythos, the award-winning sit-down dining experience within the Lost Continent at Universal Orlando's Islands of Adventure, is expected to close in 2027 as part of the phased demolition of the themed area. It is described as one of the last remaining major experiences in the Lost Continent before the planned redevelopment. No specific closure date beyond 2027 was given.

Blu Livingston, operated by Blu Hospitality Group, officially opened earlier in May 2026 at 277 Eisenhower Parkway in Livingston, New Jersey, bringing an elevated NYC-inspired dining experience to the suburbs. The sprawling space features three distinct dining rooms, a central bar, and a four-season loggia seating 285 diners, with a menu highlighting surf and turf, house-made pastas, sushi rolls, and nori tacos. The restaurant's wine program, led by General Manager Adam Greer, earned Blu on the Hudson Wine Spectator's Best of Award of Excellence in 2025.
